content.thinking:
I'm going through the claims one by one. The first is that the slowest io-shop requests loaded more slowly than usual for a stretch of time, which is what a reader would have noticed. The second is that the slowdown started when a feature changed how the shop estimates each shopper's typical spend. The third is that this new method probably slows pages for shoppers with long purchase histories, and that's the hedged part I'm still weighing.

I'm checking the remaining claims against the record. The estimate of the cost, the fact that nobody was paged since no on-call incident was linked, and that the feature flag was reverted and the revert is still in place all look supported. A proposed fix is open as a draft and hasn't been applied, and the record shows nothing after that.
